steps.label: Hochladen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && a=$(curl -sS --retry 2 --retry-delay 20 --retry-all-errors -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T sears_film3.mp4 -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(tr -d '\n' < vurl_s3.txt)"); echo "video $a"; b=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -T sears_thumb_a.jpg -H "Content-Type: image/jpeg" -H "If-None-Match: *" "$(tr -d '\n' < turl_s3.txt)"); echo "video $a thumb $b" | tee sr_up3.txt; case "$a" in 200|412) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; case "$b" in 200|412) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; : > vurl_s3.txt; : > turl_s3.txt
